body:
I've tried lots of drugs during my life, but I had the most destructive experience ever on Salvia. A couple weeks ago two ex schoolmates, who used to buy hash in the same neighborhood were I hang out, came to me with this new drug they ordered from the net. It was salvia extract 10x, and they asked me to sell it for them. Next evening I tried it by myself, in my room. I didn't even have an idea of how powerful salvia was. Even if those guys warned me several times and told me not to smoke over a dose of it each time, I smoke like six doses of it.
At first I felt like the whole room was suddenly divided into several sectors. My body was divided as well. In a split second I felt like the room sectors were 'moving' toward me, trying to englobe me. It was just a big mess. I could not see anything and I just started walking around the room, at least that was what I thought. But after the effects started to wear out, I realized that I totally wasted my room! All my clothes were scattered around, the drawers were out of place, the wardrobe's door was broken on the ground.
I'll never try that stuff again.
